text: What is the difference between a recursive procedure and a recursive process?
choices: A process is what happens when recursion is too deep
The procedure is syntactic; the process is about whether work is left pending at each level
One uses the stack and the other the heap
explanation: factorial with an accumulator is still a recursive procedure, and nothing is pending — the answer is complete when the base case is reached. That is an iterative process, which could run in constant space.
